description: Semantic layer for NL-to-query-plan mapping over flight pricing tables and deterministic SQL compilation

origin.description: IATA airport code for the origin airport

destination.description: IATA airport code for the destination airport

start_date.description: Start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: End date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

max_price.description: Maximum acceptable return fare amount in the query currency

outbound_origin.description: IATA origin code for outbound leg

outbound_destination.description: IATA destination code for outbound leg

return_origin.description: IATA origin code for return leg

return_destination.description: IATA destination code for return leg

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

cheapest_return_price.description: Lowest total recommendation fare for a return trip

cheapest_return_flight.description: Find the lowest-priced return flight between two airports within an outbound departure date range.
examples: What is the cheapest return flight from SIN to BKK?
Find the lowest return fare from SIN to BKK between 2019-09-01 and 2019-09-30.
Cheapest round-trip option from BKK to SIN in September 2019?
cheapest_return_flight.sql_template: SELECT sr.session_id, sr.currency_code, MIN(r.fare_total_amount) AS cheapest_return_price, MIN(f_out.departure_date) AS outbound_date, MIN(f_in.departure_date) AS return_date FROM search_response sr JOIN recommendation r ON r.payload_id = sr.payload_id JOIN flight f_out ON f_out.payload_id = sr.payload_id JOIN flight f_in ON f_in.payload_id = sr.payload_id WHERE sr.trip_type = 'R' AND f_out.origin_airport_code = :origin AND f_out.destination_airport_code = :destination AND f_in.origin_airport_code = :destination AND f_in.destination_airport_code = :origin AND date(f_out.departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY sr.session_id, sr.currency_code ORDER BY cheapest_return_price ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_under_budget_return.description: List return-trip destinations from an origin airport within a maximum budget and outbound departure date range.
examples: Where can I fly to from Singapore under 300 SGD return?
Show return destinations from SIN below 300 between 2019-09-01 and 2019-09-30.
Find round-trip options under 260 from BKK in September 2019.
destinations_under_budget_return.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT f_out.destination_airport_code AS destination, a.city_name, a.country_name, MIN(r.fare_total_amount) AS min_return_price, sr.currency_code FROM search_response sr JOIN recommendation r ON r.payload_id = sr.payload_id JOIN flight f_out ON f_out.payload_id = sr.payload_id JOIN flight f_in ON f_in.payload_id = sr.payload_id JOIN airport a ON a.payload_id = f_out.payload_id AND a.airport_code = f_out.destination_airport_code WHERE sr.trip_type = 'R' AND f_out.origin_airport_code = :origin AND f_in.destination_airport_code = :origin AND f_out.destination_airport_code = f_in.origin_airport_code AND date(f_out.departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f_out.destination_airport_code, a.city_name, a.country_name, sr.currency_code HAVING MIN(r.fare_total_amount) <= :max_price ORDER BY min_return_price ASC LIMIT :limit

route_departure_options.description: Return departure options between two airports in a date window, ordered by earliest departure.
examples: Show me departures from SIN to BKK between 2019-09-12 and 2019-09-12.
List BKK to SIN departures on 2019-09-19.
What are the earliest SIN to BKK departures in September 2019?
route_departure_options.sql_template: SELECT f.payload_id, f.origin_airport_code, f.destination_airport_code, fs.departure_datetime, fs.arrival_datetime, lg.flight_number FROM flight f JOIN flight_segment fs ON fs.payload_id = f.payload_id AND fs.flight_idx = f.flight_idx LEFT JOIN flight_leg lg ON lg.payload_id = fs.payload_id AND lg.flight_idx = fs.flight_idx AND lg.segment_idx = fs.segment_idx AND lg.leg_idx = 0 WHERE f.origin_airport_code = :origin AND f.destination_airport_code = :destination AND datetime(fs.departure_datetime) BETWEEN datetime(:start_date) AND datetime(:end_date) ORDER BY datetime(fs.departure_datetime) ASC LIMIT :limit

return_fare_options.description: List return fare options for a route with price breakdown and currency.
examples: Show return fare options from SIN to BKK in September 2019.
List fare breakdown for BKK to SIN return itineraries.
What are the available return prices for SIN-BKK?
return_fare_options.sql_template: SELECT r.recommendation_id, r.fare_total_amount, r.fare_amount_without_tax, r.fare_tax, r.fare_family, sr.currency_code FROM search_response sr JOIN recommendation r ON r.payload_id = sr.payload_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flight f_out WHERE f_out.payload_id = sr.payload_id AND f_out.origin_airport_code = :origin AND f_out.destination_airport_code = :destination AND date(f_out.departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flight f_in WHERE f_in.payload_id = sr.payload_id AND f_in.origin_airport_code = :destination AND f_in.destination_airport_code = :origin) ORDER BY r.fare_total_amount ASC LIMIT :limit

destinations_by_country_from_origin.description: List destination airports in a specific country reachable from an origin in a date window.
examples: From SIN, what destinations in Thailand are available in September 2019?
Show routes from BKK to destinations in Singapore between 2019-09-01 and 2019-09-30.
List destination airports in Thailand from SIN.
destinations_by_country_from_origin.sql_template: SELECT DISTINCT f.destination_airport_code AS destination, a.city_name, a.country_name, MIN(f.departure_date) AS first_departure_date FROM flight f JOIN airport a ON a.payload_id = f.payload_id AND a.airport_code = f.destination_airport_code WHERE f.origin_airport_code = :origin AND a.country_name = :country AND date(f.departure_date) BETWEEN date(:start_date) AND date(:end_date) GROUP BY f.destination_airport_code, a.city_name, a.country_name ORDER BY first_departure_date ASC LIMIT :limit
